# Silken Reason

> Decision software for the physical world.

Silken Reason creates Veyra, operational evidence for Physical AI.

Veyra is a lightweight readiness review layer for autonomous systems, Physical AI and industrial IoT.

Veyra helps teams review operational history before high-cost decisions such as deployment readiness, return-to-service, mission readiness, after-action review, operational review and machine finance readiness.

## Core Concepts

- Readiness review
- Readiness evidence
- Readiness Record
- Operational evidence
- Decision evidence
- Operational history
- Operating history
- Operational memory
- Operational knowledge graph
- Semantic execution graph
- Read-only connector
- On-site metadata aggregation
- Return-to-service review
- Mission readiness
- After-action review
- Operator trust
- Machine finance readiness
